messages:
kasia: just tried the new brew cask installer for redwoodctl on my macbook and local serve fails with a weird "“missing profile mapping”" error when i switch profiles.
omar: which macOS version + brew? also did you upgrade from an older installation?
kasia: macOS 13.6, brew 4.0.0, upgraded from the repo-built binary last week. `redwoodctl config list-profiles` shows 3 profiles but the kube-like profile ids in ~/.redwoodctl/config.json look like UUIDs not friendly names.
cli-bot: [notice] redwoodctl version 0.10.1 installed via homebrew
omar: hmm, we recently changed profile storage from name-keyed to id-keyed records to allow duplicate display names. Looks like upgrade path should migrate old name-index to id-index but maybe the cask didn't run the migration hook.
jess: does `redwoodctl profiles migrate` exist? i thought there was an auto-migrate on first run.
kasia: i ran `redwoodctl profiles migrate --dry-run` and it printed "no migration needed". but `cat ~/.redwoodctl/config.json` shows entries with `id` and `display_name`. the client cli is resolving profiles by display_name in some commands and id in others.
omar: that's a bug — commands that accept `--profile` should resolve by display_name, id, or path. filing ISSUE-501. can you paste the exact error and the command?
kasia: command: `redwoodctl local serve --profile staging`
error: `error: profile "staging" not found (found ids: ["a3f2...","4d9c...","b782..."])`
jess: workaround: use the id instead of the name for now. `redwoodctl local serve --profile a3f2...` works. not ideal.
omar: note for the release notes: we need to make the migration idempotent and force-runable. maybe `redwoodctl config migrate --force` that rewrites config and credentials to new layout.
cli-bot: PR-289 assigned to @omar (dx) for "profile resolution and migration improvements"
kasia: also the installer dropped a `~/.redwoodctl/config.json.bak` but left it with 600 perms and the new config is 644 so local serve couldn't read it when launched from launchd agent. i had to chown the file back to my user.
omar: ok add file-permissions check to the cask postinstall and add a note about launchd agents needing config accessible by the process user.
jess: thanks for reporting — heads-up to docs: add a small FAQ about profile id vs name after upgrades and mention `redwoodctl profiles list --long` to map ids to names. :sparkles:
